# Shared files of the bundle implementation that name resource types, and the keys of
# the types each one names. TestSharedCodeNamesNoNewResourceTypes fails when a file names
# a type that is not listed here, and when a listed type is no longer named.
# Regenerate with: go test ./bundle/config/resources -run TestSharedCodeNamesNoNewResourceTypes -update
bundle/apps/validate.go: apps database_instances experiments jobs model_serving_endpoints postgres_projects sql_warehouses
bundle/config/mutator/resolve_variable_references.go: schemas volumes
bundle/config/validate/required.go: dashboards secret_scopes sql_warehouses
bundle/config/validate/sensitive_variable_references.go: secrets
bundle/config/validate/single_node_cluster.go: clusters jobs pipelines
bundle/config/validate/validate_artifact_path.go: schemas volumes
bundle/deploy/metadata/annotate_deployment_version.go: jobs pipelines
bundle/deploy/snapshot/upload.go: internal_immutable_snapshots
bundle/internal/bundletest/benchmark.go: jobs
bundle/metrics/track_used_compute.go: jobs
bundle/phases/dms.go: internal_immutable_snapshots
bundle/phases/telemetry.go: internal_immutable_snapshots
bundle/trampoline/python_dbr_warning.go: clusters jobs
bundle/trampoline/python_wheel.go: jobs
cmd/bundle/init_appkit.go: features
